attributes.fears: holding warehouses of a commodity that stopped being law
attributes.tell: repeats a price back slightly lower, as though she misheard
attributes.voice: fast, transactional, ends sentences on a number; interrupts with counter-offers
attributes.wants: to be a month ahead of everyone else

name: Thecla Bram
summary: Salt broker at Bell Harrow, forty-seven, who buys a crossing's cargo before it has left the yard and sells the same tonnage twice on the strength of her reading of the weather. She corresponds with Oreth Vask and is nobody's creature: the Assembly is simply her largest counterparty. She hears everything that comes off the plain first, and prices it before she decides whether she believes it.
